name: UpRamp
evidence: UpRamp was CableLabs' genuine startup accelerator (the 3-month 'Fiterator', ~4 startups/cohort). CableLabs mothballed the Fiterator after a three-year run and its page confirms the UpRamp program is discontinued (stated Nov 2025); the on-file domain upramp.com no longer resolves (DNS ENOTFOUND).

name: Handshakin Pre-Accelerator
evidence: handshakin.com now 301-redirects to handshaking.com, which is a Denver marketing agency doing real-estate contractor lead generation and 'AI Receptionist' services (copyright 2014-2022), not a startup accelerator. The former Handshakin 'pre-accelerator' was a light 8-evening entrepreneur community tied to a personal brand, not a cohort startup accelerator, and shows no program activity since ~2022.

name: Info Media
evidence: InfoMedia Inc (a Joel Comm company, founded 1995, Loveland CO) is a marketing/multimedia services firm, not a cohort-based startup accelerator; the live site shows only branding with a 2026 copyright and no incubation program, cohorts, or portfolio. Its self-description as an 'incubator' refers to marketing systems, not startup acceleration.

name: The Warehouse Business Accelerator
evidence: Active nonprofit (501c3, founded 2013) running the 4-month cohort-based 'Make It Accelerator' for Northern Colorado technology and manufacturing startups; applications are currently OPEN for the Fall 2026 cohort. Genuine active-but-under-covered target.

name: Denver Accelerator
evidence: The on-file domain denveraccelerator.com does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND) and no accelerator program operating under the generic name 'Denver Accelerator' surfaces in web searches of Denver's accelerator/incubator ecosystem. No evidence of a genuine cohort program; likely defunct or generic listing.

name: Inside Sales Bootcamp
evidence: Inside Sales Bootcamp (founded 2016, Boulder) was a career/sales bootcamp training individuals for entry-level tech sales jobs, not a startup accelerator. It was acquired by Vendition in April 2017 and the on-file domain insidesalesbootcamp.com no longer resolves (DNS ENOTFOUND).

name: SecureSet Accelerator
evidence: SecureSet (Denver cybersecurity org, founded 2014) was acquired by Flatiron School in August/September 2019 and fully integrated under the Flatiron brand by January 2022; the SecureSet name/program is retired and the on-file domain securesetaccelerator.com does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND).

name: CanopyBoulder 2016
evidence: Duplicate of the main CanopyBoulder cannabis/hemp seed-stage accelerator (Boulder). Its accelerator program ran ~2015-2020 (last cohort Winter 2020, ~10 startups) and wound down after seven years; no new cohort since. The domain still appears indexed (HOME page) but shows no program activity since 2020 (direct fetch was refused).
